i3wm is a pretty good one with great defaults. I recommend dmenu for program launching, and nmtui for CLI network configuration.

Here's a nice cheat to test out any distro you like. I used this method a couple years back when I BIOS locked meself out of my own laptop hdd. Good times..

  1. Pick a distribution and make a live usb/cd from it. (you've got this part covered it looks like)
  2. Run the live distro, and plug in an empty external hdd, preferably a usb 3.0
  3. Install to the external drive, be careful not to touch the internal hdd.
  4. Now you can boot to your chosen distro externally and verify if it works or not. If it works really well.
